Who We Are

A Team You Can Trust

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.27.4″ _module_preset=”default” text_font=”||||||||” text_text_color=”#F1F1F1″ text_line_height=”1.7em” global_colors_info=”{}”]

At Eddie Pearson Roofing, we take pride in being one of Mississippi’s premier roofing companies, specializing in both residential and commercial roofing services. Our mission is simple—deliver top-quality workmanship with customer service that’s second to none. Whether you’re starting a new construction project or need to replace a worn or storm-damaged roof, our team is here to provide reliable roofing repair and replacement services tailored to your needs.

We are proud to be among the elite, holding the prestigious Master Elite certification from GAF—an honor awarded to less than 3% of roofing contractors nationwide. This distinction not only reflects our commitment to excellence, but it also allows us to offer GAF’s exclusive Golden Pledge Warranty. This comprehensive warranty covers both manufacturer defects and our workmanship, and it’s fully transferable should you decide to sell your home.

In addition to the Golden Pledge, we also stand behind our work with a two-year contractor’s warranty, giving our customers even more peace of mind. When you choose Eddie Pearson Roofing, you’re choosing a company with integrity, expertise, and a dedication to protecting what matters most—your home or business.
